controls.PRODUCER_CORRUPTION: External GPU producer changes one named word AFTER READY and BEFORE completion/release; consumer compares original reference, returns FAIL1 with expected exact mismatch index/count/value and control_detected.
controls.comparison_selftest: Optional separate CPU comparer mutation, always labelled comparator-only, cannot replace producer-GPU control.

fd_ownership.socket: Consumer owns only its inherited endpoint, never parent original or unrelated handles.
fd_ownership.dma_buf: Consumer owns supplied inherited duplicate; eglCreateImageKHR retains backing reference but does NOT take FD ownership; caller closes own FD exactly once.
fd_ownership.native_fence: Distinct EGL_ANDROID_native_fence_sync FD ownership rule; duplicate if provider needs retention, never apply memory-FD rules to sync FD; source contract ambiguity/failure cleanup must remain truthful.

description: Frozen proposal interface, not runtime admission or proof. Provider may refuse ambiguous details explicitly, but cannot silently invent external Intel work.

order: consumer validates pinned contract/reference, selects exact NVIDIA EGL device, creates GLES3.1 context, imports memory/image and binds texture
consumer sends READY with nonce and actual selected identity over inherited control socket
external producer writes actual GPU payload after READY and finishes its bounded real completion control

producer sends RELEASE with same nonce/source/model-independent payload contract and actual completion receipt; exactly one sync_file via SCM_RIGHTS for native-fence mode, zero for explicit host-relay mode
consumer enqueues properly imported fence wait where selected; samples all pixels into SSBO and awaits own completion under10s internal/60s externally owned parent deadline
full original reference comparison; emit one bounded strictJSON after truthful cleanup disposition

missing_gate: Incomplete external layout/producer completion/selected device/required runtime extension=>NOT_CHECKED2; actual attempted API error=>FAIL1 preserving code.
trusted_parent_inputs: selected NVIDIA PCI BDF and EGL render-node association
named producer source/build/run/identity pins supplied externally
